conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: And so, we arrived at the Boss Room...

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Yes, we were finally able to open the pub we had always dreamed of!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: MALT! We did it!

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Oh... yeah. We did it.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: The dungeon was truly the best!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: We got plenty of treasure and even found such a spacious place!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Hahaha! This is all thanks to you, MALT!

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: BOB.

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Actually... I thought you were incredibly stupid.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Oh, friend. That is true to some extent...

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: And it was an ACCURATE prediction!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Then, MALT pointed a revolver at BOB!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: I don't know how a malt could hold a revolver in its hands in the first place,

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: But anyway, what appeared before BOB’s eyes was definitely a gun barrel.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: MALT! How could you do this to me!

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: I thought you were a true friend! But you were trying to use my family as FOOOOD!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Wait, calm down! There seems to be a misunderstanding...

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Like what?

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: More than your family, I thought you would become the most magnificent BEER!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: And the gun was fired.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: When BOB opened his eyes, there was nothing to be seen around him.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: His closest friend MALT had vanished without a trace...

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: BOB was left all alone in the empty dungeon.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Saddened by the parting with his friend, BOB wanted to commemorate MALT in his pub.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: He erected a grand statue of MALT and told the customers about the legend of MALT.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: BOB made delicious beer with the malts he worked hard to grow...

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: And just like that, BOB's shop began to rake in a lot of money!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: In this DEEP, deep dungeon.
